mintAuthority.summary: Avalanche avUSD authorizes the immutable AvantMintingV2 gateway. Complete Routescan-indexed MinterUpdated and role-event replay through block 96542832, corroborated by pinned membership reads, identifies one active token minter and one gateway MINTER_ROLE caller. The common token owner/gateway admin can replace minters and raise the cap; Avant's archived address-specific disclosure identifies this admin as a 3-of-4 MPC controlled by core team members.

controls.label: Avant avUSD AvantMintingV2 contract
controls.capDescription: Verified source enforces supported collateral transfer, exact stable-value ratio at the current zero-delta setting, authorized MINTER_ROLE caller, and maxMintPerBlock. The current cap is 25,000,000 avUSD per Avalanche block.
controls.evidence: Routescan MinterUpdated logs from deployment through Avalanche block 96542832 contain three events: the original gateway was enabled then revoked, and AvantMintingV2 remains the sole active token minter. Pinned minters(address) reads corroborate both active and revoked memberships; maxMintPerBlock remains 25,000,000 avUSD and stablesDeltaLimit zero. The earlier zero proxy-slot observations and verified constructors remain evidence of immutable code. PublicNode replay was attempted in 869 bounded 50,000-block chunks but historical queries returned not found; enumeration relies on the complete explorer index, not those failed RPC reads.

controls.label: AvantMintingV2 MINTER_ROLE caller
controls.capDescription: This EOA can call the immutable gateway, but each call remains bounded by collateral transfer, signature and route validation, and the 25,000,000 avUSD per-block gateway cap.
controls.evidence: Complete Routescan RoleGranted/RoleRevoked logs from gateway deployment through Avalanche block 96542832 identify this address as the sole active MINTER_ROLE member; the original member was revoked. Pinned hasRole reads confirm the active and revoked memberships. The gateway's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can raise the cap; the caller cannot. The archived December 31, 2025 governance post prints Avalanche MPC 0xD5456b9A997768601bEdF15f91C0500943C698D, a malformed 39-hex-character identifier that does not match this active 40-hex-character caller. General issuer MPC policies therefore do not establish address-specific custody for this caller; its custody, signing threshold and vendor remain unverified.

controls.label: Avant avUSD token owner and gateway admin

sources.label: Avant address-specific admin MPC disclosure, December 31, 2025 (archived March 9, 2026)

controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 96542832, avUSD.owner() and the gateway's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE identify this address; eth_getCode is empty. Immutable AvUSD.setMinter lets the owner authorize arbitrary native minting, and the gateway admin can raise maxMintPerBlock without a fixed maximum. Avant's December 31, 2025 governance disclosure names this exact admin address as a 3-of-4 MPC of core team members with parameter and cross-chain authority. Current issuer security docs corroborate MPC and approval policies, while vendors remain NDA-only. MPC custody does not establish an immutable cap, independent timelock or whole-supply reconciliation.

review.evidence: Complete Avalanche role and MinterUpdated event replays through block 90283689, followed by direct hasRole() and minters(address) checks, establish one gateway caller and one active token minter. maxMintPerBlock() returned 25,000,000 avUSD, stablesDeltaLimit() returned zero, and the common admin/owner EOA can raise the cap or replace minters. Verified constructors and zero EIP-1967 slots establish immutable token and gateway code. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the issuer EOA can raise the cap or replace minters without an independent timelock, while no whole-supply recurring reconciliation or prudential supervisor is evidenced. Wave 2 external review 2026-08-15: Avant's live API reports dated strategy NAV, assets, and financing liabilities, but it does not reconcile aggregate avUSD token liabilities across Avalanche and every CCIP spoke, so reconciliation remains unknown. Reconciliation determination 2026-08-15: retained unknown with a named gap. The Avant transparency API reports NAV and asset/liability totals only on dated snapshots (2026-08-04 at the R02 refresh), and neither it nor the curated-validated adapter establishes liability coverage across the Avalanche mint hub plus the Monad CCIP spoke; the issuer EOA can replace token minters immediately, so supply expansion between dated snapshots escapes the feed. A live whole-supply liability join would qualify this for continuous/periodic. Wave 1 reconciliation review 2026-08-15: the live Avant transparency API is dated and reports strategy assets, liabilities, and NAV, but it does not join total avUSD token liabilities on Avalanche and the Monad CCIP spoke to those reserves; no named recurring attestation was found, so reconciliation remains unknown and supervision remains none.
